canonical_title: Flotation devices - air vehicles with escape and ejection systems

versions.title_at_revision: Flotation devices - air vehicles with escape and ejection systems
versions.text:
Standard: For air vehicles with ejection seats, the flotation device (if used) will remain functional and automatically inflate when the ejected crewmember enters seawater. The device will be dual chambered with an oral inflation capability. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: The flotation device will be included during windblast tests of the ejection system and AFE up to the maximum rated velocity of the ejection system. Verify that the system remains intact during the windblast test and properly inflates when exposed to seawater.
(2) Lab test: The floatation device will be included during sled testing of the ejection system and AFE up to the maximum rated velocity of the ejection system. Verify that the system remains intact during the ejection sled testing and properly inflates when exposed to seawater.
